card.name: "Fatal or" in DRESS warnings
card.fires_on: The word "or" in the stock sentence "Some of these events have been fatal or life-threatening," in DRESS (multi-organ hypersensitivity) warnings.

modes.label: Fatal or life-threatening
modes.description: The word "or" right after "fatal" in the DRESS warning, just before "life-threatening".
modes.example: Some of these events have been fatal<< or>> life-threatening. DRESS typically, although

card.plain: It fires on the word "or" in the repeated DRESS warning line that says some events were fatal or life-threatening.
